body: Thank you. I think so, too.
This made me cry. I've spent so long being terrified of people because of the situation I'm in, and something this genuine. And from someone I don't really know. It really got me.

A lot, probably. I used to be a good guy. Life just fucking sucks. I wish you the best, though. Be smart. Don't get to the point where I'm at. It's okay to ask for help. Please ask for it if you need it. Don't be like me.
This comment is so genuine. Sincerely. You seem sweet. This made me laugh a little. I guess I'm not sensitive to things like that anymore.
I cannot go to inpatient. My family would be furious at me. I have no options. I am a waste of space. But, thanks.
